material.description: CI run 39491847470 (sha 27443996) and run 39491643610 (sha 9bed119) both fail job 'browser page probes - map, reconnect, self-reload and rejected edit' at the draw3d step: page.waitForFunction drawTerrain > 0 times out at 30 s. Red before the moba_input refusal commit 2744399, so not caused by it. Owner files: js/client/play.js, render3d.js, tiles.js, fx.js (other lane). Also job 'static checks' fails 'naming comments FAIL sc2=1' from a tracked file outside moba_input.js.
material.subject: Browser probe draw3d red on main: drawTerrain stays 0
material.witness: CI run 39574774312 job 119141473425 at sha 24ac524: step draw3d logs draw3d ok mode=3d terrain=1 doodad=2 unit=28 quad=0, so drawTerrain > 0 holds. The job failed later at the moba range refusal probe, a different row.
